hero.subheadline: The Workout Plant is Williamsburg's private 1-on-1 personal training & nutrition coaching studio @ 139 Frost St. Improve strength, body composition, and overall fitness with our proven program.

thePlan.headline: Simple, Evidence-Based Systems That Actually Work
thePlan.intro: Led by Head Coach Izzy Jacobus, whether you train with Izzy or one of our trainers, you follow the same structured, evolving program.
thePlan.philosophy: Our approach is built on proven principles: progressive strength training, evidence-based nutrition, and sustainable habits. No fads. No unnecessary complexity. Just a structured, personalized system designed for lasting results.

pillars.title: Individual 1:1 Strength Training
pillars.description: Each 60-minute private session combines progressive strength training with kickboxing or mat pilates and is tailored to your individualized goals.

pillars.title: Evidence-Based Nutrition Coaching
pillars.description: While we specialize in plant-based nutrition, all dietary approaches are supported with a plan tailored to your body composition goals.

pillars.title: 24/7 App & Direct Messaging Accountability
pillars.description: Coaching doesn't stop when you leave 139 Frost St. Through direct messaging and The Workout Plant App, you get:

trainers.name: Izzy Jacobus
trainers.bio: Creator of THE PLAN, Izzy brings years of experience in strength training, nutrition, and wellness coaching. A former nutritional counselor at Brooklyn Nurse Practitioners Clinic, he specializes in advanced training, specific strength and athletic goals, and more individualized coaching.
trainers.quote: A little over a decade ago, I was obese, sedentary, and struggling with chronic pain that made even everyday activities difficult. I started rebuilding my health with small steps. Walking led to bodyweight exercises, and eventually yoga, kickboxing, and strength training. What began as an effort to reclaim my own health became a passion for helping others do the same.

trainers.name: Analine Ignacio
trainers.bio: Analine combines strength training with a passion for movement, mobility, and mat Pilates. As an instructor at YO-BK, she takes an encouraging, thoughtful approach to helping clients build strength, improve mobility, and develop sustainable fitness habits. She believes that lasting physical change starts with a shift in mindset.
trainers.quote: “During the pandemic, I gained 40 pounds and struggled to lose it. Telling myself I was lazy, I started asking why I was struggling with motivation and what I could do to change it. I began looking at the reasons behind my stress eating and mindless eating rather than only focusing on the weight itself. This led me to changing my behaviors and adopting positive reinforcement which resulted in losing the weight. So, if you’re looking for a trainer who will yell at you or call you lazy, I’m not the one for you! I believe there’s always more to the story, and understanding ourselves is an important part of making lasting changes. Fitness shouldn’t be about punishing yourself; it should be about learning to support yourself.”

trainers.name: Dev Buchanan
trainers.role: Junior Personal Trainer & HIT Pilates Instructor
trainers.bio: Dev combines her passion for strength training with her experience teaching mat and Inferno Pilates at YO-BK. Her coaching blends strength, conditioning, and Pilates-inspired movement to help clients build confidence, improve their fitness, and feel stronger in everyday life.
trainers.quote: I've always been passionate about fitness, cycling through phases of spin, CrossFit, jiu-jitsu, and strength training. But for a long time, partying and unhealthy habits took priority over consistency. In 2023, I made the decision to commit to sobriety for good. Strength training became my anchor, giving me structure, transforming my body composition, and helping me rebuild my confidence. What began as a personal transformation grew into a passion that ultimately inspired me to pursue fitness professionally.

faqs.question: How often do I need to train to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend most clients train two to three times per week, depending on their goals.

faqs.question: What should I wear and bring?
faqs.answer:
Wear something comfortable and bring a water bottle. We have a water fountain and see bottled water and other drinks.

No shoes in the studio! We provide towels.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and rescheduling policy?
faqs.answer: No refunds. Reschedule up to 48 hours before your session. No-shows are charged the full session amount.

faqs.question: What happens if I arrive late?
faqs.answer:
Arrivals 15+ minutes late are charged in full and the session is cancelled.

Arrivals 10+ minutes late may result in a shortened session.

faqs.question: Where is the studio located?
faqs.answer: 139 Frost St, Brooklyn, NY 11211 in Williamsburg.

faqs.question: How do I know which trainer to choose?
faqs.answer:
Choose Head Coach Izzy for advanced strength training, specific athletic or physique goals, or more complex training needs. His specialty modality is kickboxing.

Choose Analine for strength and conditioning, fat loss guidance from someone with firsthand experience, or a movement specialist with a background in dance and acting. Her specialty modality is HIIT Mat Pilates.

Choose Dev for strength and conditioning, building confidence and consistency, or a supportive approach to developing healthier habits. Her specialty modality is Inferno Pilates.

All sessions are private, one-on-one, and 60 minutes long.

faqs.question: Will there be an initial consultation with my trainer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once you book your first session, your trainer which reach out to you with an  onboarding questionnaire and to discuss your needs and goals.

faqs.question: Is there a locker room or shower?
faqs.answer: We have a private bathroom for changing and cubbies for storing items but we do not have a full shower.

policies.firstTimers: If this is your first session, send a message to introduce yourself and let us know if you have any limitations, concerns, or questions—or if you'd like a brief phone consultation.
policies.attire: Wear something comfortable and bring a water bottle. No shoes in the studio! We provide towels and everything else you'll need.
policies.cancellation: No refunds. Reschedule up to 48 hours before your session. No-shows are charged the full session amount.
policies.late: Arrivals 15+ minutes late are charged in full. Arrivals 10+ minutes late may result in a shortened session.
policies.philosophy: Our evidence-based foundation: 2–4 strength sessions per week using compound movements (1–2 reps from failure), paired with ~0.7g of protein per pound of goal bodyweight.
